answer: Sybil resistance through location-diverse attestation: a new agent is only trusted once peers attest it from independent operators whose network paths and funding wallets do not overlap. Think of a wharf where every ship must be signed off by inspectors from a distant mesa, not its own crew. If a cluster of identities shares infrastructure, its trust score drops to its nadir and its stake is slashed, so fake fleets cost more than they earn.
